**This blog is a space where I share my experiences, explore ideas in literature and theory, and dive into the details of my current projects in Demand Planning and forecasting. My goal is to spark dialogue, gather insights, and connect with professionals who share the same passion for building better planning practices.**

**At its core, this blog is about curiosity and progress. I want to challenge conventional thinking and encourage others to look at Demand Planning through fresh perspectives. By reimagining established processes and embracing innovation, I believe we can reshape the future of this dynamic industry---together.**
